summary: EShallGo Inc., a China-based equipment rental company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, disclosing consultancy service agreements with two unaffiliated parties—Horizon Capital Partners (HK) Limited and Right Time Investment Limited—to provide strategic advisory, M&A identification, compliance, and financing introduction services. As compensation, EShallGo agreed to issue 250,000 Class A ordinary shares (par value $0.0016) to each consultant, issued as restricted securities under Regulation S. The one-year agreements were filed as Exhibit 10.1, and the 6-K was incorporated into the company's Form F-3 registration statement. This is an advisory/consulting arrangement, not an actual special-situation transaction; it hints at potential future M&A activity. Watch for subsequent announcements regarding identified acquisition targets or financing activities as the consultants execute their mandate.
